result.rationale: The diff adds totalPages: Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. With e.g. user_count=100, limit=50, totalPages=3 even though only 2 pages exist; showingLast (currentPage==totalPages) then permits the 'next' action to set offset=100 and fetch an empty member list, exactly as the finding describes. The mechanism is fully verifiable in the diff (admin-group.js.es6 totalPages/next action and group.js findMembers offset clamp).
